name: Butter Lettuce
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated in SIBO due to minimal fermentable content. Can be eaten freely as part of low-FODMAP meals.
preparationTips: Wash leaves gently and pat dry to maintain delicate texture
Use whole leaves as wraps for low-FODMAP proteins
Add to salads at the end to prevent wilting
Store with roots attached in water for longer freshness
nutritionalHighlights: High in vitamin K for bone health
Contains vitamin A for eye health
Very low in calories and high in water content
